releases.displayName: 🏰 Ironhold Base Major Update Is Here 🏰

items.text: The Ironhold Base Major Update is out now!
After your countless victories, yet another challenge emerges. Enter the Ironhold Base. Gather your troops once again, choose the best tactic, adapt, and overcome as you always have.
Fixed: LB does not function during the retreat tutorial on controllers
Added Steam Deck icons
Font in game scaled from 1 to 1.1
Added virtual keyboard support for Steam Deck

A fastpaced, military tug-of-war game with minimal micromanagement. Choose and deploy from a mix of specialized military units to overwhelm the enemy. Experiment with a huge variety of unit compositions, synergies, abilities, and upgrades to lead your army to victory!

releases.displayName: Halloween Update Haunts Operation: Polygon Storm!

items.text: Salutations, Commanders!
We hope that you’re hungry for combat and some pumpkin juice. As the Spooky Season approaches, we’ve prepared some treats for you…
HALLOWEEN EVENT ╾━╤デ╦︻

From October 25th to November 6th, mysterious occurrences might happen during your battle… It’s time for the Halloween Event! Your enemies might turn into something uncanny and you’ll enjoy Airport and Fallen City maps in their spookiest version yet! Lock n’ load and get ready for some horrific mayhem!
If you want to relive the scares and frights, worry not, for the Holiday Event System we implemented in this patch allows you to toggle the Halloween event from the Menu.
TOXIC BARREL ╾━╤デ╦︻
A new, treacherous ability that enemies will bring for 4 last maps. Watch your step!

notes.title: But that’s not all! In the update, you’ll also find

items.text: scrolling for abilities and units in the loadout menu
all-new, shiny camo patterns, so your troops can stay hidden AND stylish
You no longer have to replay The Last Company map to unlock a new DLC map. Have fun!

notes.title: Also, reminder about the DLC we released a couple days ago

items.text: Stay tuned for more news!
